title: Invoices & Billing
note: Computed by checks_dashboards_demo.py from the frozen .psv rows, with the same definitions truths.out uses. Each value carries the SQL it came from; Phase B2 holds every widget to these numbers.

kpis.label: Billed this month
kpis.sql: SELECT round(sum(amount + tax_amount), 2) FROM dash_demo.invoices WHERE date_trunc('month', issue_date) = date_trunc('month', DATE '2026-09-30')

kpis.label: Collected this month
kpis.sql: SELECT round(sum(amount), 2) FROM dash_demo.invoice_payments WHERE date_trunc('month', paid_date) = date_trunc('month', DATE '2026-09-30')

kpis.label: Open amount
kpis.sql: SELECT round(sum(amount + tax_amount), 2) FROM dash_demo.invoices WHERE status IN ('open', 'overdue', 'partially_paid')

kpis.label: Overdue amount
kpis.sql: SELECT round(sum(amount + tax_amount), 2) FROM dash_demo.invoices WHERE status = 'overdue'

kpis.label: Invoices in scope
kpis.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.invoices i WHERE true AND i.issue_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND i.issue_date < DATE '2026-09-30' + INTERVAL 1 DAY

kpis.label: Billed from trade orders %
kpis.sql: SELECT round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN i.source = 'order' THEN i.amount + i.tax_amount ELSE 0 END) / sum(i.amount + i.tax_amount), 2) FROM dash_demo.invoices i WHERE true AND i.issue_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND i.issue_date < DATE '2026-09-30' + INTERVAL 1 DAY

density.rule: a monthly bar of events, company totals
density.sql: SELECT min(n) FROM (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM dash_demo.invoices i WHERE true AND i.issue_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND i.issue_date < DATE '2026-09-30' + INTERVAL 1 DAY GROUP BY date_trunc('month', i.issue_date))
SELECT count(DISTINCT i.customer_id) FROM dash_demo.invoices i WHERE true AND i.issue_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND i.issue_date < DATE '2026-09-30' + INTERVAL 1 DAY
